_comment: Desktop performance gate. See docs/13 §5 and docs/14 §3b.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: lighthouserc.json collects mobile only. The cinematic
layer (docs/10 Amendment 1) is DESKTOP-ONLY — it hard-stops below 1024px and
on pointer:coarse — so the mobile config is structurally incapable of
measuring what it costs. Mobile TBT proves ISOLATION (that mobile never loads
the chunk); it says nothing about the users who actually get the feature.
docs/13 §5 has carried a 'Desktop LCP <= baseline + 150 ms' row with no
collector behind it. This is the collector.
preset 'desktop' (not 'perf') because desktop is not just a viewport: it also
swaps throttling from mobileSlow4G/4x-CPU to desktopDense4G/1x-CPU and changes
the user agent. Setting formFactor alone would emulate a desktop screen while
still simulating a throttled phone, and the resulting numbers would describe
no real user. onlyCategories restores the performance-only scope that 'perf'
gave the mobile config, since Lighthouse allows only one preset.
Home route only: the cinematic layer is home-only, and desktop's one known
CLS defect (the 100dvh route fallback) is observable there.
Run with the Windows one-at-a-time loop in docs/13 §6 — lhci autorun with
numberOfRuns > 1 crashes on this machine.
aggregationMethod 'median' is set EXPLICITLY. lhci defaults to 'optimistic',
which for a maxNumericValue assertion tests the BEST of the 5 runs — not the
median that docs/13 §5 says these rows are. lighthouserc.json (mobile) still
carries that default and so is a weaker gate than it is documented to be.
Thresholds: LCP 695 = measured baseline 545 + the 150 ms allowance already in
docs/13 §5. CLS 0.05 is the §5 desktop row. TBT 150 was a new row, OWNER-
APPROVED 2026-07-19: desktop TBT baselines at exactly 0 ms across all 5 runs,
so any nonzero desktop TBT after Phase 5 is attributable to the canvas and
nothing else — 150 ms leaves room for a shader while catching a CPU hog.
